name: Ancient Tactician
summary: At the start of your Command phase, if this model is on the battlefield, you gain 1CP.

name: Anvil of Endurance
summary: While this model leads a unit, if a model in it is destroyed by a melee attack before fighting this phase, roll a D6: on a 4+ it is not removed yet, fighting after the attacking unit finishes before being removed.

name: Battle-lust
summary: Each time this model ends a Charge move, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its Frostfang weapon until the end of the turn.

name: Berserk Charge
summary: This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Bestial Fury
summary: Advance and Charge rolls made for this model can be re-rolled.

name: Bestial Rage
summary: In your opponent's Shooting phase, if this model lost a wound from an enemy unit's attacks, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6+2".

name: Blizzard Shield
summary: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

name: Champion of the Kingsguard
summary: Each melee attack this model makes against a Character unit can have both its Hit roll and Wound roll re-rolled.

name: Cunning Hunters
summary: Each attack a model in this unit makes can re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or re-roll the Wound roll entirely if the target is within range of an objective marker.

name: Deadly Stalkers
summary: Each attack a model in this unit makes against an enemy unit gains +1 to the Wound roll if no other enemy units are within 6" of the target.

name: Death Totem
summary: Each melee attack the bearer makes can re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

name: EMBARKING WITHIN TRANSPORTS
summary: This model can embark within friendly Adeptus Astartes transports that can carry Terminator models, taking up the space of 4 Infantry models.

name: Fervour of the Ancients (Aura)
summary: While a friendly Space Wolves unit is within 6" of this model, add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

name: FORCE OF UNTAMED DESTRUCTION
summary: This model cannot be selected as your Warlord.

name: Gift of the Iron Wolf
summary: In your Command phase, select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle within 3" (once per turn, shared with Blessing of the Omnissiah): it regains up to D3 wounds and one of its ranged weapons gains Rapid Fire 1 until your next Command phase.

name: Guile of the Wolf (Aura)
summary: Once per turn, when your opponent targets one of their own units within 12" of this model with a Stratagem, you can add 1 CP to that Stratagem cost.

name: Hammer Blow
summary: After this unit fights, select one hit enemy Monster or Vehicle unit: until the end of the next turn, its attacks suffer -1 to their Hit roll.

name: Headhunters
summary: At the start of the battle, select an enemy unit as this unit's quarry: its weapons gain Devastating Wounds and Precision against that quarry (even while embarked), and a new quarry is chosen whenever the current one is destroyed.

name: Healing Balms
summary: While this model leads a unit, in your Command phase you can return 1 destroyed non-Character model to it.

name: Heroic Last Stand
summary: If this model is destroyed by a melee attack before it has fought this phase, roll a D6: on a 2+ it is not removed yet, fighting after the attacking unit finishes before being removed.

name: Hunting Hounds
summary: While this unit is within 6" of a friendly Space Wolves Character model (excluding Wulfen) and is not Battle-shocked, its models have an Objective Control characteristic of 1.

name: Judgement of the Omnissiah
summary: Each attack this model makes against an enemy unit within Engagement Range of a friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit can have its Wound roll re-rolled.

name: Legendary Tenacity
summary: Each attack against this model whose Strength exceeds its Toughness has -1 applied to its Wound roll.

name: Let Loose the Wolves
summary: At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, this unit splits into a Headtakers unit and a Hunting Wolves unit, each with a new Starting Strength.

name: Murder-maker (Aura)
summary: In the Fight phase, if an attack destroys a model in a friendly Wulfen unit within 6" of this model before it has fought, roll a D6: on a 4+ it is not removed yet, fighting after the attacker finishes before being removed.

name: Oathbound
summary: While this model leads a unit, melee attacks made by models in it gain +1 to the Hit roll, and also +1 to the Wound roll against a unit matching this model's Slayer's Oath keyword.

name: Predatory Instinct
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit and this unit is not within Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move of up to D6".

name: Rugged Resilience
summary: Each attack against this unit whose Strength exceeds its Toughness has -1 applied to its Wound roll.

name: Savage Frenzy
summary: Each non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy unit within Engagement Range of this unit that Falls Back must take a Desperate Escape test, at -1 if it is Battle-shocked.

name: Slayer’s Oath
summary: Choose Character, Monster, or Vehicle at battle start as this model's Slayer's Oath. When its unit first destroys a matching unit, it gains its Detachment's Saga benefit (if any) as if completed, for the rest of the battle.

name: Tempered Ferocity
summary: While this model leads a unit, weapons equipped by models in it have the Sustained Hits 1 ability, and attacks against an enemy unit within 6" can re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

name: Tempest’s Wrath (Psychic)
summary: After this model's unit shoots, select one hit non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy unit struck by its Living Lightning weapon: until your next turn, ranged weapons equipped by that unit's models have their Range reduced by 6" (minimum 12").

name: Thunderous Charge
summary: Each melee attack a model in this unit makes with its Wolf Guard weapon gains +1 to the Damage characteristic if it made a Charge move this turn.

name: Violent Fury
summary: If this model is equipped with two melee weapons, those weapon profiles have the Twin-linked ability.

name: War Howl
summary: While this model leads a Blood Claws unit, its melee attacks can re-roll the Wound roll; while it leads a Wolf Guard Headtakers unit, that unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Wind Walker (Psychic)
summary: While this model leads a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in it have the Assault ability, and each time the unit Advances it skips the Advance roll and instead adds 6" to its Move characteristic until the end of the phase.
